'''Dorsk 79''' was the genetic predecessor to [[Dorsk 80]], and the seventy-ninth [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]] named [[Dorsk]]. When [[Dorsk 81]] returned to [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]] after studying at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Dorsk 79 expected him to return to his job despite Dorsk 81 being lauded for being the first Khommite to do something special in over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="EGTAS" />
